product_name: Bajaj Life Guaranteed Pension Goal II
regulatory_descriptor: A Non-Linked, Non-Participating, Individual/Group General Annuity Plan
key_benefits: Guaranteed lifelong annuity income; annuity amount is guaranteed at policy inception and paid at the chosen frequency (Yearly/Half-yearly/Quarterly/Monthly)
Immediate Annuity: annuity payable in arrears from inception; Deferred Annuity: annuity payable from the end of the chosen deferment period (1-30 years; 10 years max for Options G and H)
Option B: Life Annuity with Return of Purchase Price (ROP, 50%-100% chosen at inception) on death — the only option available through the POS channel (immediate annuity, fixed ROP%)
Option C: Annuity certain (5/10/15/20 years) and life thereafter (immediate annuity only)
Option D/E: Joint Life Last Survivor with 50% or 100% annuity to spouse (D immediate only; E deferred only with regular premium)
Option F: Joint Life Last Survivor with 100% annuity to spouse and ROP on death of last survivor (single-premium deferred: ROP mandatorily 100%)
Option G: Life Annuity with Return of Purchase Price on death or survival — purchase price returned after the 25th policy year or age 85, whichever is later (single premium only under deferred)

Option H: Life Annuity with Return of Purchase Price on death or in instalments on survival — 5% of purchase price per year from the 15th policy year or age 70, whichever is later, until 100% is returned (single premium only under deferred)

Option I: Family Pension (NPS subscribers only) — Option F terms with a spouse, Option B terms without; ROP re-purchases annuity for dependent mother then father; 100% of purchase price on the last death
Death during the deferment period pays Death Benefit Factor x Total Premiums Paid, minimum 105% of Total Premiums Paid
Policy loan available under ROP options once Surrender Value is acquired (up to 80% of Surrender Value)
Higher annuity rate for single premium of Rs 5 lakh+ or regular premium of Rs 2 lakh+; annuity increased by 2% for superannuation/pension/NPS purchase price (staff: 4.5% / 2%)

eligibility.entry_age_note: Immediate annuity 30-85 years; Deferred annuity 35-84 years, subject to annuity starting at a maximum age of 85. Different entry ages apply when the purchase price comes from a Bajaj Life deferred pension policy, QROPS or NPS.
eligibility.min_purchase_price: As per minimum annuity instalment: Rs 12,000 yearly / 6,000 half-yearly / 3,000 quarterly / 1,000 monthly (minimum annuity not applicable when purchased from a superannuation fund, pension fund/policy or NPS fund)
eligibility.max_purchase_price: No limit, subject to Board Approved Underwriting Policy
eligibility.policy_term: Whole-life annuity (immediate) / deferment period 1-30 years chosen at inception (deferred; 1-10 years for Options G and H)
eligibility.premium_payment_term: Single Premium (immediate or deferred); Regular/Limited Premium 2-12 years (deferred annuity only); deferment period for regular/limited premium is at least the greater of 2 years and the PPT chosen
eligibility.note: Annuity option and ROP proportion, once chosen at inception, cannot be changed. Quarterly and monthly premium frequencies only with auto-debit.

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from the date of receipt of the policy document (electronic or otherwise), except policies with tenure under a year; refund within 7 days of the request. For QROPS purchases the proceeds return only to the originating fund house per HMRC rules; for NPS purchases per NPS/PFRDA guidelines.
key_terms.grace_period: Deferred annuity with regular/limited premium only: 30 days for frequencies other than monthly, 15 days for monthly. Death during the grace period pays the death benefit less unpaid premiums.
key_terms.suicide_clause: Deferred annuity during the deferment period only: on suicide of the Annuitant (or last survivor) within 12 months of commencement or latest revival, the higher of 80% of Total Premiums Paid or the Surrender Value is payable. No suicide clause or other exclusion applies during the annuity period or under an immediate annuity.
key_terms.guaranteed_benefit_note: The annuity amount is guaranteed at inception and depends on the purchase price, age, frequency and the annuity option chosen ('Conditions Apply'). Return of Purchase Price proportion (50%-100%) is chosen at inception and cannot be changed.
key_terms.surrender_note: Surrender Value available under ROP / Annuity-Certain options: during the deferment period the higher of GSV or SSV; after the deferment period the SSV. GSV is a proportion of the purchase price (single premium) or of total regular/limited premiums; SSV factors are not guaranteed. A surrendered policy cannot be revived.
key_terms.paid_up_note: Regular/limited premium deferred annuity: fewer than one full year's premiums -> lapse with no benefit; one full year paid -> paid-up annuity and survival benefit.
key_terms.revival_note: Within 5 years of the first unpaid premium; arrears plus interest currently 10% p.a. compounded half-yearly (benchmarked to 10-year G-Sec + 2%).
key_terms.loan_note: Available only where the annuity option carries Return of Purchase Price and the policy has acquired Surrender Value; maximum 80% of Surrender Value; outstanding loan plus interest deducted from death/surrender value and each annuity payment adjusted for loan interest; current loan interest 10% p.a. compounding half-yearly (V09 brochure stated 9%), benchmarked to 10-year G-Sec + 2%; policy must be assigned to the company.
key_terms.tax_note: As per applicable tax laws, subject to amendment; GST and cess collected over and above the premium.

mandatory_disclosures_present: Grace period, paid-up and revival disclosure
POS channel restriction (Option B immediate annuity only)
'Conditions Apply' caveat on the guaranteed-income headline

claims_marketing_must_support: Any 'guaranteed income for life' claim must carry the 'Conditions Apply — depends on purchase price and annuity option chosen' caveat present in the brochure.
Return of Purchase Price (ROP) is option-specific (Options B, F, G, H, I) and the percentage (50%-100%) is chosen at inception — any 'get your money back' claim must be option-qualified.
Joint-life / spouse-continuation benefits apply ONLY to the joint-life options (D, E, F, and I for NPS subscribers).
Annuity-certain payout (Option C) is for the chosen 5/10/15/20-year guaranteed period and is available under immediate annuity only.
Survival-benefit return of purchase price (Options G and H) is tied to the 25th policy year / age 85 or the 15th policy year / age 70 thresholds, whichever is later.
Loan availability must be qualified: ROP options only, after Surrender Value is acquired, up to 80% of Surrender Value.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT present this as a market-linked / wealth-creation or growth product — it is a non-linked, non-participating annuity that pays a fixed guaranteed income.
Do NOT use 'bonus' language — the plan is non-participating.
Do NOT imply the annuity rate is the same for everyone — the annuity amount varies by option, purchase price, age and frequency.
Do NOT promise return of the full purchase price unconditionally — ROP only applies under specific options and at the chosen percentage.
Do NOT omit that the annuity option, once chosen at inception, cannot be changed during the policy term.
Do NOT cite the superseded UIN 116N187V09 for current collateral — the current approved version is 116N187V11.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor (Non-Linked, Non-Participating Annuity Plan)
'Conditions Apply' caveat for the guaranteed-income claim (dependent on purchase price and annuity option)
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document / benefit illustration for full terms and exclusions
